# Hamiltonian Matrix

The Hamiltonian matrix is a $2n\times 2n$ matrix $A$ such that $JA$ is
symmetric, where $J$ is the skew-symmetric matrix
$$
J=\begin{bmatrix}
0_{n} & I_{n}  \\
-I_{n} & 0_{n}
\end{bmatrix}
$$
and $I_{n}$ is the $n \times n$ identity matrix.
